seo.loginDescription: Access the Hotels-PMS hotel management system.

login.title: Sign in to your account
login.description: Sign in with your password or Google. New Google users can create a hotel, and invitees can join with the email they were invited to.
login.slowHint: The connection is taking longer than usual. We are trying to sign you in without losing your data.
login.mfaDescription: Confirm your identity with your authenticator or recovery code.

errors.invalidHotel: The authentication response did not include a valid hotel.
errors.signInGoogle: Unable to sign in with Google
errors.signInApple: Unable to sign in with Apple

register.title: Create an owner account
register.description: Complete your details and verify your email to configure the hotel.
